product.title: 10 Must-see Spots in Kyoto One Day Private Tour (up to 7 people)

description.text: In Kyoto, this private eight-hour circuit starts at Kitaoji Station and covers ten published sights with a guide handling district transfers for one group of up to seven. The listed route includes Kinkaku-ji, Arashiyama Bamboo Forest Street, Tenryu-ji Temple, Togetsukyo Bridge, Arashiyama Kimono Forest, Fushimi Inari-taisha Shrine, Kiyomizu-dera Temple, Sannenzaka and Ninenzaka, Yasakanoto, and Gion. Navigation stays with the guide so the day can hold both the north-city pavilion and the east-side temple lanes. The format suits visitors with a short stay who want a single guided sweep rather than assembling ten tickets independently. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Kyoto, and the itinerary stays on Kinkaku-ji, Arashiyama, Fushimi Inari, and Kiyomizu-dera that define this outing rather than an Osaka transfer.

start.description: Meet the guide at Kitaoji Station in northern Kyoto, then continue the published ten-stop circuit.

end.description: Return to your Kyoto meeting point after the final stop on the itinerary.
